run_dummy_data_generation: run the script to generate XTREME-S audio dummy test data for Afrikaans
run_generate_data: run _generate_data to create dummy wav files for train, dev, and test splits
run_make_wav_file: run _make_wav_file to generate a random 2-second 16kHz mono wav file at a given path
run_filepath: run _filepath to construct the output wav file path for a given language, split, and wav name
run_output_dir: run _output_dir to get the base output directory for XTREME-S dummy data generation
